witness.quote: <italic>E. coli</italic> (BL21-DE3) transformed with the pASK-IBA2 plasmid bearing Fluc constructs
Synthetic gene constructs for Fluc-Ec2, Fluc-Bpe, Fluc-La1, and Fluc-La2 were inserted into a pASK vector with a C-terminal LysC recognition site and hexahistidine tag (TRKAASLVPRGSGGHHHHHH)

construct.qualification: The listed constructs are distinct proteins; their shared methods sentence does not show coexistence in this Ec2 current measurement.

current_measurement.meaning: dominant insertion-step magnitude, not a preparation mean or time-averaged current

witness.quote: Most of these insertion-steps are 1.8 pA under these conditions, equivalent to 7 pS

current_measurement.preparation: Fluc-Ec2 liposomes 0.1 microgram protein/mg lipid; planar POPE/POPG bilayer

baseline_witness.quote: zero current is defined as the mean level of the fully closed channel

current_measurement.baseline_qualification: A defined closed-channel baseline does not quantify a protein-free bilayer background contribution.

witness.quote: with 300 mM or 30 mM NaF, 15 mM Mops-NaOH pH 7, in the cis or trans chamber respectively, trans defined as electrical ground

salt_conditions.concentration_ratio: 300/30 nominal concentration; the source separately describes an eightfold ionic activity gradient
salt_conditions.reversal_applies_to_current: source-supported conditional interpretation across the stated salt-gradient arrangement, not a paired same-bilayer observation

witness.quote: first-insertion current histograms for 63 separate insertion events taken from ∼50 bilayers

reversal_witness.quote: Reversal potentials from 4–5 separate bilayers were 53 ± 1 mV and 119 ± 3 mV for salt-gradient and bi-ionic conditions, respectively.

sampling.qualification: Counts of insertion events and bilayers are not counts of independent protein preparations. The separate four-preparation Poisson-dump experiment is not borrowed.

witness.quote: precludes a definitive conclusion that the observed single-channel currents are mediated by a single pore rather than two in parallel

unit_assignment.qualification: No per-pore or per-polypeptide normalization is performed.

witness.quote: with single-molecule turnover of ∼10<sup>7</sup> F<sup>−</sup> ions/sec at −200 mV

author_reported_inferred_ion_turnover.measurement_kind: source interpretation of unitary electrical current under ion/unit assignments
author_reported_inferred_ion_turnover.qualification: Preserved as a source inference; the implemented charge-equivalent cell is not silently relabeled as experimentally isolated fluoride flux.

witness.quote: bi-ionic conditions (300 mM NaF//300 mM NaCl)

biionic_contrast.contrast_kind: constructed incompatible pairing of two reported measurements, not a new experiment or synthetic measurement
biionic_contrast.effect: The119mV source point and its own physical key survive, while the inappropriate salt-current/biionic-reversal chord is unavailable.

formal_correction.meaning: The correction swaps La1/La2 labels for specified Figure1A sequence rows; it is not a new experiment and does not change the selected Ec2 electrical quantities.
